scientific_integrity: Forward one-dimensional stationary distributions and all moments were previously known; the present claim is the complete two-moment inverse fiber classification and exact distinct-law witness, with an accompanying alternative beta-product representation. Publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: One spatial dimension, symmetric two-direction run states, positive memoryless run and rest rates, no thermal diffusion, stationary population moments, and known trap/velocity scales. Finite-sample identification and general noisy dynamics are not addressed.
title: An exact two-moment inverse fold in a trapped run-and-tumble particle
